# apple_beta_tester (Resource)

Adds a TestFlight beta tester to beta groups. `beta_group_ids` is authoritative: groups the tester belongs to that are not listed, including other apps' groups, are removed. A tester whose email is already registered is adopted. Destroying the resource deletes the tester, which removes their access to every app. Import it by its App Store Connect ID or email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_beta_tester" "ann" {
  email          = "ann@example.com"
  first_name     = "Ann"
  last_name      = "Tester"
  beta_group_ids = [apple_beta_group.public.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `beta_group_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the beta groups the tester belongs to. Changes are made in place.
- `email` (String) Email address of the tester. Changing it creates a new tester.

### Optional

- `first_name` (String) First name of the tester. Changing it creates a new tester.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the tester. Changing it creates a new tester.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta tester.
- `invite_type` (String) How the tester was invited: `EMAIL` or `PUBLIC_LINK`.
- `state` (String) State of the tester's invitation, e.g. `INVITED` or `ACCEPTED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_tester.ann
  identity = {
    id = "4f2e1d0c-9b8a-4766-a5f4-e3d2c1b0a998"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta tester.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By App Store Connect ID or by email.
terraform import apple_beta_tester.ann 4f2e1d0c-9b8a-4766-a5f4-e3d2c1b0a998
terraform import apple_beta_tester.ann ann@example.com
```
